note: Type signatures for typed planning. Not a pin and not policy: eligibility still comes from operator_policy.json via resolve().

folder.description: A directory under the allowed root (snapshotted by an adapter before use).

inventory_file.description: .csv/.json file with columns id,group,bytes (the operator CONTRACT).

canonical_rows.description: JSON array of {id,group,bytes} rows sorted by key (convert output).

group_summary.description: Per-group count and bytes over accepted inventory files, plus the quarantine list (merged.json).

inventory_diff.description: Rows added, removed and changed between two inventories. No registered capability produces it (the C3 gap).
inventory_diff.behaviour_spec: Compare a BEFORE and an AFTER inventory. Input env: {"files":[{"format":"json","text":BEFORE},{"format":"json","text":AFTER}]} where each text is convert's canonical output: a JSON array of {"id","group","bytes"} rows, ids unique within a file, row order arbitrary. Output: ONE JSON text {"added":[rows only in AFTER],"removed":[rows only in BEFORE],"changed":[{"id","before":{"group","bytes"},"after":{"group","bytes"}} for ids in both whose group or bytes differ],"unchanged":<count of ids in both with equal group and bytes>}. Rows are {"bytes","group","id"}. Every list is sorted by id (Python string order, code points). Serialise with json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(",",":")) (ensure_ascii default).

snapshot.label: engineering adapter (operator_runtime.snapshot_dir), not a learned capability
snapshot.verifier: type check: intake_check + structured_verifier.parse_source in INVENTORY_SCHEMA
